intro.title: Bank Reconciliation & Auto-Matching
intro.subtitle: CSV statement uploads, digital UPI/card receipt reconciliation, and period clearance

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 8, Part 5: Uploading Bank Statements and Auto-Reconciliation. Seamlessly bridge your bank accounts with counter collections, card swipes, and UPI settlements.
Under Accounting, click Bank Reconciliation and select your primary current account to inspect differences between book balances and cleared bank entries.
Upload your bank's CSV statement. MediFlow parses dates, reference IDs, withdrawal debits, and credit deposits automatically.
Click Auto-Reconcile. MediFlow matches UPI references, card batch settlements, and exact rupee values to pair verified records instantly.
Accept confirmed matches and lock the reconciliation period with complete immutable audit verification. This concludes Phase 8 Accounting tutorials!

outro.takeaway: Bank Reconciliation: Eliminate manual ledger tick-marking with intelligent CSV statement upload and automated UPI matching.
